exposure: Admitting hospital (Universitas Academic Hospital vs Pelonomi Tertiary Hospital)
outcome: Discharge status (discharged, down-referred, died, remained admitted)
cohort: The study included 129 neonates weighing less than 1 000 g admitted to Universitas Academic Hospital and Pelonomi Tertiary Hospital.
finding: Mortality and morbidity rates among extremely low-birthweight neonates remain high, with neonatal sepsis identified as the leading cause of death.
followup_time: Short-term outcomes, including the neonatal period (up to 28 days of life) for mortality causes; the study period ran from August 2021 to July 2022.
birth_weight: Less than 1 000 g (Extremely Low Birth Weight)
